page_title: BitMatch: camera card offloads. Safe, fast, verified, free.

summary.name: BitMatch
summary.one_liner: BitMatch is a free, open-source macOS app that offloads camera memory cards to several drives at once and verifies every copy with SHA-256.
use_cases: backing up footage to several drives at once
verifying copied video files match the card
queuing multiple memory cards while copying
generating offload reports and ASC MHL records
summary.what_it_does: BitMatch reads a camera card once and writes it to every selected drive at the same time. Each copy is read back from the drive and compared with the card using SHA-256, with four verification modes from quick copy to byte-by-byte. It lets you queue several cards, each with its own progress row and result. It recognizes folder layouts from Sony, Canon, ARRI, RED, Blackmagic, Panasonic, Fujifilm, GoPro, DJI, Insta360 and plain DCIM cards, and writes PDF, CSV and JSON reports plus ASC MHL records.
notable: Writes to several drives in one read of the card
Read-back verification using SHA-256 with four modes
Signed, notarized, open source, and self-updating
caveats: Described as beta software from a one-person project
Asks once for permission to access drives on first use
